analysis.title: GS Kaplan - A few observations from today 14 Oct 2026
key_insights: Goldman's Kaplan describes 14 Oct as several factors coming together: mixed Fed commentary into CPI, AI funding concerns, weak AI/Semis backdrop, and building stagflationary pressure.
Market was underpricing the likelihood of more Fed hikes being priced in through 2027. December hike odds settled at about 88% on the day.
AI funding concerns (where we are in the equity capital market cycle) and credit market/funding conditions for Neoclouds drew growing focus. Questions on CRWV were high.
Semis show a lack of EPS-driven relief. ASML finished -3.94% in NY, raising the question of whether beats will be rewarded this quarter. Semis have had 6 consecutive down sessions, which is uncommon.
Positioning within Mag7 has crept notably higher over the past few weeks, while 3m implied vols for Mag7 look low.
GS Stagflation Pair (GSPUSTAG) had a top move YTD, indicating stagflationary pressures continuing to build.
Desk investor activity was underwhelming, but client conversations indicate investor anxiety is high.
Info tech sell skew hit its highest in more than 4 weeks, driven by long-only supply and hedge fund long and short supply.

Index vol has been muted but factors and thematics have been moving. Low Quality/Junk basket finished down 4.5%, the only flagship basket with a >3 std dev move, and the Quality Pair is up 13.6% over the last month.
SPX ex. AI basket finished +61bps, a top 5 move versus SPX YTD.

earnings_insights: Kaplan asks whether semis will be rewarded for earnings beats this quarter, citing ASML -3.94% in NY on 10/14.
Mag7 implied vol is near multi-year lows, which Goldman says means the cost to hedge these names through earnings and year-end is not high enough.
